scope: Frozen controller source, source-bound test declarations and dependency interfaces only

findings.finding: Early bootstrap capture accepts an ancestor only when a complete non-option argv item resolves exactly to the Python source file. A PowerShell launch with -Command and the whole launch script in one argv item has no such item. The actual owned launching shell is silently omitted; interpreting the whole command as a path can also raise before the early preparer receipt is written.
findings.source_counterexample: Parent argv consists of a PowerShell executable, -Command and one script string that invokes the interpreter and the source path. No argv element equals the source path. The existing any(...) predicate is false and the while loop breaks with only the Python identity captured.
findings.impact: Bootstrap RSS and the later known/preparer closure union may omit an actually owned launch parent. This is separate from historical unknown parents, which must remain unknown and must not be adopted retrospectively.
findings.minimum_correction: Use a narrow trusted declaration/provenance check for the actual direct launch parent, capture its exact PID/create_time before validation, and stop explicitly if a required owned parent is missing or unconfirmed. Do not infer ownership by admitting arbitrary system ancestors or arbitrary command substrings.

findings.finding: The final240 deadline is checked at line351 before ResearchLock.__exit__. After lock release, line355 calls pulse(force=True), whose deadline is the common6000 end, but does not check the final phase deadline again.
findings.source_counterexample: The last phase check occurs just before final_deadline. A successful lock release lasts less than the ten-second observation limit but ends after final_deadline and before the common end. The post-release pulse succeeds; status and error_history remain positive, so line357 can qualify a final phase longer than240 seconds.
findings.impact: The promised final240 cap does not cover the complete final release path even though the common deadline and gap guard remain enforced.
findings.minimum_correction: After lock release, check the existing absolute final_deadline_monotonic as well as the original common clock; preserve the same prior observation and sticky failure behavior. No new clock or allowance is needed.
